label: Verification independence versus existential relevance
note: These are analyst-stipulated criteria. Neither independent verification nor a response flag establishes ultimate existential relevance. Historical attribution is DEFERRED by owner; prior tentative reading findings remain in docs/notes/explanatory-adequacy-750.md.
resolution: Logical verification independence concerns a class of basic sentences entailing the antecedent condition without entailing the target over unrestricted logical valuations. Modal coextension concerns truth throughout accessible worlds, which may already obey a law. It does not settle logical independence. Intervention relevance concerns responses under admissible settings; response data and causal admissibility are extra inputs. Actual concrete existence in the finite model is explicit Ontic/Profile framework data, not empirical identification or production of a worldly existent.
